summary: Join our Project Lifecycle Management in Oil and Gas Training Course to gain vital insights and skills for managing projects efficiently in the industry.
lede: Project Lifecycle Management in Oil and Gas provides a practical, end-to-end framework for planning, executing, monitoring, and closing projects with greater discipline and clarity. It helps professionals control scope, schedule, cost, risk, and interfaces across every lifecycle phase. The course shows you how to define and justify opportunities, govern projects through stage gates, and coordinate engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, and handover. You will also learn to integrate HSE, quality, and regulatory requirements while managing stakeholders and communicating progress confidently.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for professionals in the oil and gas industry and related sectors who manage or support projects throughout the lifecycle. This course is designed for: Project managers and project engineers in upstream, midstream, and downstream. Facilities and operations engineers involved in capital or brownfield projects. Project controls, planning, and scheduling professionals. Asset managers and field managers overseeing project portfolios. HSE and quality professionals involved in project planning and execution. Procurement and supply chain professionals supporting EPC and contractor management. Finance and commercial teams involved in project appraisal and approvals. Maintenance and reliability engineers involved in shutdowns and turnarounds. Business development and strategy teams evaluating project opportunities. Anyone contributing to planning, executing, monitoring, or closing oil and gas projects.
modules: Foundations of Project Lifecycle Management in Oil and Gas
Front End Engineering Design (FEED) and Definition
Planning and Project Controls Across the Lifecycle
Commissioning, Start Up, and Handover to Operations
Lifecycle Risk, HSE, and Regulatory Management
Lifecycle Closeout, Lessons Learned, and Continuous Improvement
prerequisites: Participants should have prior experience in project management within the oil and gas industry. Familiarity with project lifecycle stages and basic project management tools is recommended.
